description.short_caption: Diffuse vesiculopustular rash on the chest and abdomen of a child.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the chest and abdomen of a child with a widespread vesiculopustular rash. The lesions are numerous, discrete, and distributed across the torso. Some lesions appear to be in different stages of development, with a mix of vesicles, pustules, and crusted lesions. The skin surrounding the lesions appears otherwise normal, without significant erythema.
visible_findings: lesions in various stages of development
